transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because I just... I keep avoiding things. Anything that reminds me of my old job, really. If I have to go near certain office buildings, or if there's a security briefing, or even just networking events near work sites, I just dodge them. And if anyone starts asking about the day it happened, I just make up an excuse and leave. I just can't deal with it.
Do you ever find yourself reliving what happened through unwanted memories, flashbacks, or nightmares?

Yeah, I do. It happens out of nowhere, really. I'll just be... washing the dishes, or driving past a warehouse gate, and the whole scene just pops back into my head. It's so sharp. I can actually hear the panic in people's voices all over again, and my chest just tightens up, exactly like I'm right back there.
How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?
It's been going on since I was fired after that armed incident. That was... about a year and seven months ago now.
